resources.string: After selecting resolver sources, Steam APIs, Store, Community, chat, media and CDN hosts are resolved dynamically on demand without scanning and pinning an IP first.
No resolver sources are currently enabled
No Steam DNS entries cached yet
Entries expire automatically. Clearing the cache makes the next Steam request resolve again.
Coverage includes Steam mobile APIs and service subdomains under steampowered.com, steamcommunity.com, steamstatic.com, steamusercontent.com, steam-chat.com and known Steam CDN host families.
Enabled sources participate directly in live app-scoped resolution. Custom DNS accepts HTTPS resolver URLs as well as traditional DNS IPs or hostnames.
DNS providers can see the public Steam hostnames queried by Monica Steam. Account credentials, Steam Guard secrets, cookies, tokens and chat message contents are never sent to DNS providers.
System DNS, built-in HTTPS DNS, and saved custom DNS sources are selected and benchmarked together here. Disabled sources do not participate in live resolution or full scans.
Manage custom DNS in one place. Enter an https:// DNS endpoint above or a traditional DNS IP/hostname; HTTPS entries can optionally use multiple bootstrap IPs below.
HTTPS DNS entries are also available in the ECH server selector. Traditional DNS uses port 53.
Bootstrap IPs let an HTTPS DNS hostname connect without asking system DNS first. Multiple IPv4/IPv6 literals are supported; HTTPS still verifies the original hostname.
Bootstrap IPs apply only when the DNS address above is an https:// endpoint. Add traditional DNS IPs or hostnames directly as resolver sources.
Add the HTTPS DNS endpoint above and, optionally, literal bootstrap IPs below. The two inputs stay separate so the resolver hostname can be reached without system DNS first.
Optional IPv4/IPv6 literals. Multiple addresses can be separated by commas or spaces. HTTPS still verifies the hostname from the DNS URL.
Enter only valid IPv4/IPv6 literals, separated by commas or spaces.
Use the same resolver as main DNS or choose any built-in or saved HTTPS DNS independently.
Follow the current main DNS resolver source
Prefer IPv6 when HTTPS DNS or system resolution returns both families, while keeping IPv4 fallback. Traditional custom DNS currently still queries A records.
Live dynamic resolution off · tap to configure sources
Recommended for everyday use: configure once and resolve automatically without pinning Steam IPs or requiring a scan first.
A separate mechanism: scan and verify current IPs, then write app-scoped Hosts entries. Because IPs are pinned, rescan and apply again when the network changes.
